article_content: Valve has released SteamVR 2.0, updating its VR interface to match modern Steam and Steam Deck standards. This update - previewed in beta last month - replaces the old dashboard with a streamlined layout featuring a side toolbar for Library, Store, Friends, and Downloads. The design mirrors Steam Deck's UI for consistency. Users now see remote battery levels and access notifications directly. Steam Chat and Voice Chat integration lets players message friends within VR. A dual-cursor keyboard supports multiple languages and emoji sending. Bug fixes include multitasking toggles for Windows 10/11 and improved desktop window icons. While this update adds OpenXR developer tools, Valve hasn't announced plans to refresh its $1,000 Valve Index headset. Rumored 'Deckard' hardware remains unconfirmed, though Apple's upcoming Vision Pro headset may reignite VR interest in 2024.

Desain mirip dengan antarmuka Steam Deck untuk konsistensi. Pengguna sekarang dapat melihat level baterai remote dan mengakses notifikasi langsung. Integrasi Chat dan Voice Chat Steam memungkinkan pemain mengirim pesan ke teman dalam mode VR. Papan ketik dua kursor mendukung bahasa multi dan pengiriman emoji. Perbaikan termasuk tombol toggle multitasking untuk Windows 10/11 serta ikon jendela desktop yang lebih baik. Meski menambahkan alat OpenXR untuk pengembang, Valve belum mengumumkan rencana pembaruan untuk headset Valve Index $1.000-nya. Informasi spekulatif tentang hardware 'Deckard' tetap belum terkonfirmasi, meskipun headset Vision Pro Apple yang akan datang mungkin menghidupkan kembali minat pada VR pada 2024.

article_content: Sir Richard Branson described the anguish of observing his son Sam's emergency evacuation from the Matterhorn's summit during a charity expedition. Suffering acute altitude sickness, the 29-year-old experienced respiratory failure and violent vomiting 500 meters from the peak. Guided by mountaineering expert Kenton Cool, Sam persevered to reach the summit before being airlifted by rescuers who winched him from the mountain. Richard, flying nearby in a helicopter with limited fuel reserves, witnessed the dramatic rescue. The climb concluded the Virgin Strive Challenge's multi-leg charity event, raising over £600,000 for the Big Change initiative supporting youth skill development.

Didampingi oleh ahli pendaki Kenton Cool, Sam berhasil mencapai puncak sebelum diangkut oleh tim penyelamat menggunakan alat tarik kabel. Richard, yang terbang di dekat lokasi dengan helikopter bahan bakar habis, menyaksikan pengevakan dramatis tersebut. Pendakian ini menutup rangkaian acara Virgin Strive Challenge yang telah mengumpulkan lebih dari £600.000 untuk mendanai inisiatif Big Change yang mendukung pengembangan keterampilan non-akademis bagi remaja di Inggris.

article_content: UEFA’s disciplinary panel has sanctioned four clubs—Steaua Bucharest, Debrecen, Maribor, and FC Chikhura Sachkhere—for racist incidents during Champions League and Europa League qualifiers. Each faces partial stadium closures. UEFA stated, 'The fight against racism is a top priority,' reaffirming its zero-tolerance policy. Debrecen was penalized after racist behavior during their July 22 match against Cliftonville. Steaua and Maribor were cited for incidents in their July 23 fixtures versus Stromsgodset and HSK Zrinjski, respectively. Chikhura’s ban stems from a July 24 Europa League qualifier against Bursaspor. Clubs must close specified stadium sections for their next European matches. Steaua hosts Kazakh side Aktobe in the third-round Champions League qualifier (Wednesday, following a 2-2 first-leg draw). Chikhura plays Neftci in the Europa League third round (Thursday, tied 0-0). Debrecen travels to Belarus facing BATE Borisov (1-0 lead), while Maribor visits Maccabi Tel Aviv (1-0 advantage).

article_content: NEW DELHI: The World Cup final eclipsed Diwali's traditional impact, propelling India's domestic air traffic to a record 4.6 lakh passengers on Saturday. In contrast, Diwali 2023 saw unexpectedly low demand, with daily flyers often dipping below four lakh. Analysts cite inflated advance fares—introduced by airlines months earlier—as the primary deterrent. These pricing strategies drove travelers toward premium train classes instead. Union Aviation Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia hailed the milestone: 'A historic moment for Indian aviation! We transported 4,56,748 domestic passengers on November 18.' Mumbai Airport also marked a record 1,61,760 passengers in a single day, celebrated by Adani Group's CEO Gautam Adani. The surge contrasted with November's earlier sluggish air travel, an anomaly for festive seasons. Airlines had raised advance fares from late September, discouraging budget-conscious travelers. With demand stagnant, carriers slashed fares to regain market share. An industry insider observed: 'The Diwali slump defies easy explanation—perhaps post-pandemic behavioral shifts. The November 18 record reflects World Cup excitement, with Ahmedabad tickets flying off shelves.' Aviation analyst Ameya Joshi explained: 'The surge combined return travel, Chhath Puja observances, and cricket fever. November's first 18 days saw 72.4 lakh domestic flyers versus October's 73.4 lakh, underscoring the festive season's unexpected challenges.'

Berbeda dari tren sebelumnya, musim Deepawali kali ini justru mengalami penurunan permintaan dengan jumlah penumpang harian sering di bawah 4 lakh. Para ahli menuding naiknya tarif tiket jauh-jauh hari oleh maskapai sebagai penyebab utama, yang membuat calon penumpang beralih ke kereta api kelas premium. Menteri Penerbangan Jyotiraditya Scindia menyatakan: 'Ini adalah momen sejarah bagi transportasi udara Indonesia! Kami membawa 4,56,748 penumpang pada 18 November.' Bandara Mumbai juga mencatat rekor baru dengan 1,61,760 penumpang dalam sehari, disambut baik oleh CEO Adani Group, Gautam Adani. Fenomena ini kontras dengan kondisi lesunya penerbangan di awal November, yang langka terjadi saat musim liburan. Maskapai yang sebelumnya menaikkan tarif tiket jauh-jauh hari, akhirnya harus menurunkan harga untuk menarik penumpang. Sumber industri menyebut: 'Penurunan Deepawali ini misterius - mungkin pengaruh pola perjalanan pasca-pandemi. Antusiasme Piala Dunia justru membuat tiket ke Ahmedabad laku keras.' Analis Ameya Joshi menambahkan: 'Kenaikan penumpang dipengaruhi oleh arus pulang, perayaan Chhath Puja, serta geliat sepak bola. Jumlah penumpang November hingga 18 hari pertama (72.4 lakh) bahkan kalah dari Oktober (73.4 lakh), menunjukkan dinamika unik musim ini.'

article_content: Terrorist groups are reportedly developing bombs designed to bypass airport security systems, prompting U.S. demands for enhanced security measures at overseas airports connected to America. Intelligence suggests collaboration between Yemen-based Al-Qaeda in the Arabian Peninsula (AQAP) and Syria's Al-Nusra Front. AQAP was responsible for the failed 2009 'underwear bomb' attack targeting a Detroit-bound flight. New threats reportedly involve non-metallic explosives or surgically implanted devices to evade detection. The Department of Homeland Security is collaborating with international partners to update security protocols, including increased random screenings and stricter scrutiny of electronic devices. While no immediate threat has been identified, officials emphasize ongoing efforts to adapt to evolving risks. British authorities have implemented similar measures without disclosing operational details.

article_content: Bristol-based designers at Kinneir Dufort have developed a conceptual 3D pancake printer combining facial recognition with batter deposition technology. The system uses Computer Numerical Control (CNC) to translate facial features captured via computer vision into precise batter application patterns. Darker areas are printed first using thicker batter, followed by lighter layers, with cooking timing controlled through algorithmic monitoring of viscosity, application speed, and griddle temperature. While still a playful prototype, the innovation demonstrates emerging food printing capabilities. Separately, Norwegian engineer Miguel Valenzuela created the Lego-based PancakeBot, demonstrating similar principles by printing intricate designs like galloping horses and text onto pancakes through controlled batter flow systems.

Sistem CNC-nya mengubah citra wajah menjadi koordinat pemberian adonan, mulai dari area gelap (dengan adonan lebih tebal) hingga bagian terang. Algoritma mengatur waktu memasak agar tidak gosong atau setengah matang. Proyek ini masih dalam tahap konsep imajinatif, namun menunjukkan potensi besar teknologi makanan masa depan. Di Norwegia, Miguel Valenzuela membuat PancakeBot dari Lego yang bisa mencetak desain rumit seperti kuda berlari atau tulisan dengan presisi, membuktikan konsep ini bisa diwujudkan secara sederhana.
